chapter: Boston, Buffalo and finding a style
title: Playing the Silver Grill in Buffalo
summary: The band played the Silver Grill restaurant-nightclub, starting about 8:30 and working forty minutes on, twenty off.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: And you played, where did you play, mostly in Buffalo or did you travel around?
I played one place in Buffalo. The name of the place was called the Silver Grill.
At that time it was a little restaurant, nightclub, like --
How many sets did you play in those days?
Oh, let's see. We started, I'd say, around maybe 8:30 or 9:00 o'clock and ended up around 1:00, something like that.
That's right. Yes, come to of it, think it was.
